test_title: PYST 38: SSC MTS 2022 - English (Held On: 19 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question: **Direction: Four sentences are given, out of which three have spelling errors. Choose the sentence with all correctly spelt words.**

options.text: He was arrested for drunkeness on his way to the football ground.
A dumbbell is a short bar with weigts on either side.
He was quite humorus, and I liked that about him

solution:
The correct answer is **"His performance exceeded all expectations."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence **"His performance exceeded all expectations"** has all correctly spelt words.
 
• **"Exceeded" **is the correct spelling of the word, not **"exceded."**
 
• **"Expectations"** is the correct spelling of the word, not **"expections."**
 
• **"His"** and **"all"** are also correctly spelled.

Therefore, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2: "drunkenness"** is the correct spelling of the word, not **"drunkeness."**
 
• **Option 3: "weights"** is the correct spelling of the word, not** "weigts."**
 
• **Option 4: "humorous"** is the correct spelling of the word, not **"humorus."**
